method: Actual evaluated mesh view-facing adjacency edges. Target-only ray tests establish self-silhouette, full-scene first-hit rays establish geometric visibility. Panel nearest distances are restricted to verified physical construction branch and <=0.25 px subsegments. Supports use named side x at the exact original observed y, never nearest-any-side. No convex hull, no dropping records or expanding source cuts.
